notes.rule: Observation source strings carry a kind prefix followed by an optional colon-separated sub-kind: kind[:sub_kind][:detail].
obsidian:primary covers the agent's own management vault; obsidian:external covers user note vaults watched separately.
notes.example: source=obsidian matches both via the prefix filter on GET /api/observations

notes.rule: The pair (source, ref) is the idempotency key on POST /api/observations and a re-post of the same pair updates the pending row instead of duplicating it.
